name: @jarroba/mcp-logs
description: MCP server (stdio, local) that lets an AI read a log file it could never fit in its context: a 200 MB CI log. Detects the format, counts EVENTS (a 40-line stack trace is one), resolves root causes, groups lines into templates, answers when it started, and orders rotated logs by time. 11 tools, ~4.8k tokens of context.
